q: In Lamentations, what is new every morning?
quote: They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!

q: In Lamentations, what does the writer call great in the LORD?
In Lamentations, to whom is the LORD good?
why: And to the soul who seeks Him.
quote: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.

q: In Lamentations, why are we not consumed?
quote: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.

q: In Lamentations, the ruined city once full of people has become like what?
quote: She who was great among the nations has become a widow.

q: In Lamentations, how is it good to wait for the LORD's salvation?
quote: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.

q: In Lamentations, after examining our ways, what should we do?
quote: Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.

q: In Lamentations, what does the people's prayer ask God to renew?
quote: renew our days as of old

q: In Lamentations, the princess of the provinces has become what?
quote: The princess of the provinces has become a slave.
